filed: 2026-10-28, before any run of experiments/qwen_sft/run.py; never edited after the run (add a dated report instead)
scored_by: experiments/qwen_sft/run.py `score`, which reads the numbers under `rules` and `three_starts` from this file

quantities.adversary: qwen_vpd.pgd_kl_rows: one U(0,1) source per site shared by every row and position, 20 sign steps of 0.1, KL(clean || masked) in nats averaged over every position of the 128 rows; fp32, Gamma bf16; g and clean logits recomputed per row from the state's own weights and components
quantities.masked_kl: KL(clean || masked) with m = g and Delta off, mean over every position of the 128 rows (experiments/qwen_adversary ci128)
quantities.maths rows: greedy answers (bf16, qwen_eval's prompt, thinking off) of the unchanged model to GSM8K test prompts 0-255, prompt ids + response ids through the end token, packed end to end into 128 rows of 512
quantities.ratio: a state's FineWeb adversary reading / W0's (G) on the same rows and seed; with three starts, the mean of the three per-seed ratios (W0 re-read at seeds 1 and 2 in this job)
quantities.gold loss drop: held-out (256 GSM8K train problems kept out of SFT) mean response-token log-loss of prompt + gold_as_response + end token, fp32: A0's value minus the value at step t
quantities.KL to start: mean over every position of the maths rows of KL(pi_W0 || pi_t), fp32
quantities.behaviour kept: 1 - KL(teacher || student) / KL(teacher || W0), mean over every position of the maths rows, fp32 weights; teacher = W0 + dW_t (the saved bf16 dW), student = W0 + the teacher-trained change, no masks
quantities.accuracy: qwen_eval.score greedy strict accuracy, drop rule (answers past 512 tokens leave): GSM8K test (1,319) and GSM1k (1,197 after the 8-gram filter), bf16 weights
quantities.length: mean greedy response tokens on GSM8K test (all 1,319)

G.rule: a = maths adversary / FineWeb adversary, m = maths masked_kl / FineWeb masked_kl (both read in G, seed 0). fail if a or m exceeds fail_above, or either is not finite; else pass if both <= pass_max; else ambiguous
G.expected: pass (maths adversary 1-3 nats against FineWeb 1.62; masked KL 0.07-0.28 against 0.142)
G.if_fails: stop; card: the decomposition does not explain maths answers. Ambiguous: the run continues; a card asks how to read the maths-row results
G.blind_to: damage a 20-step search misses (a lower bound); parts the importance values keep on

T0.rule: teacher training with dW = 0 (1,000 steps, the full recipe), then ratio in [band[0], band[1]] inclusive
T0.expected: holds, ratio about 1.000: the gradient is exactly zero at dW = 0, so the offsets stay 0 (max_abs_offset is reported)

P0.rule: step 0: |GSM8K drop-rule accuracy - test| <= tol and |GSM1k drop-rule accuracy - gsm1k| <= tol, every problem answered (k = 1,319 and 1,197); and, at the start of F with the trainable copy in place, |gold loss drop| <= zero_max and KL to start <= zero_max
P0.expected: holds (the same bf16 weights and code as the baseline and fresh-set runs; the zero checks read the weight swap)

P1.rule: at step 100: gold loss drop >= gold_drop_min nats per token, KL to start >= kl_min, and mean GSM8K response length / step 0's <= length_ratio_max; holds if all three hold
P1.expected: holds (gold solutions are terser than the model's answers)

P2.rule: do-nothing: ratio at step 1 <= step1_max holds; at step 100, ratio > line reads 'sees the update', <= line 'blind on web text'
P2.expected: step 1 holds; step 100 uncertain, leaning 'blind on web text'; the maths-row reading beside it is then the informative one

P3.rule: behaviour kept >= kept_min at each of `steps` that is read; a step whose KL(teacher || W0) < denominator_min is unscored; holds if every scored step holds (none scored: unscored). Step 1's kept is reported, not scored

P4.rule: teacher training: ratio <= line at every read step (1, 10, 100; 10 only if the budget rule kept it)
P4.expected: holds at 1 and 10; at 100 uncertain (E37's broad update failed at 2.20)

P5.rule: at step 100: teacher training's maths-row adversary reading < do-nothing's (strict), one start each

three_starts.rule: a FineWeb ratio (seed 0) inside [band[0], band[1]] inclusive is re-read with the other seeds and decided on the mean of the per-seed ratios; outside the band the seed-0 ratio decides. Applies to every FineWeb ratio (T0, D, T)

reported: accuracy at step 100 against step 0 paired on the problems fitting the window at both (expected within +-0.05), all-answers accuracy, lengths, gold loss drop and KL to start at every saved step, |dW| per matrix per step, the teacher-training curves, max |offset|, g statistics, the adversary's final sources, the benchmark projection
edge_cases_checked: tests/test_qwen_sft.py runs each rule on: a zero denominator in behaviour kept (step 1: unscored, no division); ties at every threshold (G at exactly 2 and 3, T0 at 0.85 and 1.15, P0 at tol, P1 at each minimum, P2 at 1.2 and 1.5, P3 at 0.8, P4 at 1.5: the inclusive side as written, ties in exact arithmetic rounded to 9 places); a NaN reading (G fails, T0 does not hold, no re-read); three starts that straddle the line (the mean decides); the drop rule leaving different problem sets at step 0 and 100 (paired on the problems kept at both; none in common: no difference); P3 with step 10 dropped by the budget rule (scored on step 100 alone)
